We call it a busy season. HSE's latest figures call it something else.

891,000 workers in Great Britain had work-related stress, depression or anxiety in 2025/26. That's about half of all work-related ill health, and 18.2 million working days lost.

Number 2 changed my evenings. Writing down where I left things means my brain stops carrying it home.

Do you check work messages after hours? Be honest.

Save this for your next Sunday night, and send it to the colleague who replies to emails at 11pm.
